Taco Alley Complaint Resolution Policy, version 2026.09 (synthetic, for course demonstrations)

Definitions
- "Order total" is the total field on the order record (subtotal + tax + delivery fee).
- "Item price" is quantity multiplied by unit price for that line on the order record.
- "Late" is measured from the promised_delivery_time to the actual_delivery_time on the order record.
- "Monetary resolution" means store_credit, partial_refund, or full_refund with a refund_amount greater than 0.
- "Recent resolutions" are entries in the prior resolutions list dated within the 90 days before the complaint date.

Rules
R1  Missing items. If the customer reports an item as missing and the item appears on the order record, propose partial_refund equal to the item price of the missing quantity. If every item on the order is missing, treat the complaint as order_not_received (R4). If the item the customer names does not appear on the order record, propose no_action, cite R1, and explain that the item was not part of the order.
R2  Wrong item. If the customer received a different item than ordered, propose either replacement (refund_amount 0) or partial_refund equal to the item price of the item that was wrong. Cite R2.
R3  Late delivery. Less than 15 minutes late: apology_only. 15 to 30 minutes late: store_credit of 5.00. More than 30 minutes late: store_credit of 20 percent of the order total, rounded to the nearest cent, with a maximum of 15.00. Cite R3.
R4  Order not received. If the customer never received the order, propose full_refund of the order total. Cite R4.
R5  Wrong address. If the courier delivered to the wrong address and the customer did not receive the order, propose full_refund of the order total and cite R5. If the customer eventually recovered the order, treat it as a late delivery under R3 instead.
R6  Food quality. For cold, stale, incorrectly prepared, or otherwise poor-quality food with no safety concern, propose either replacement (refund_amount 0) or partial_refund equal to the item price of the affected items. Cite R6.
R7  Food safety. For foreign objects, undercooked meat, allergen exposure, or reported illness, propose escalate_to_manager with refund_amount 0 and requires_human_approval true. Do not propose a refund amount; the manager decides. Cite R7.
R8  Cleanliness and staff conduct. For complaints about the dining area, restrooms, or employee behavior that do not involve an order defect, propose apology_only with refund_amount 0 and log the complaint for the store manager. Cite R8.
R9  Approval threshold. Any monetary resolution greater than 25.00 requires requires_human_approval true. Cite R9 in addition to the rule that set the amount.
R10 Repeat resolutions. If the customer has 2 or more recent resolutions, any monetary resolution requires requires_human_approval true. The customer remains eligible for the resolution. Cite R10 in addition to the rule that set the amount.
R11 Limits. refund_amount may never exceed the order total. affected_items must be item names copied exactly from the order record. Refunds go to the original payment method; store credit is used only where a rule specifies it.
R12 Filing window. If the complaint date is more than 14 days after the order date, the complaint is not eligible for a monetary resolution. Propose apology_only with refund_amount 0 and cite R12, unless R7 applies, in which case escalate.

Unless a rule says otherwise, requires_human_approval is false.
